en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 3. Muhammad ibn `Ali Majilwayh (RA) said, on the authority of his paternal uncle Muhammad ibn Abu al-Qasim, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Abu `Abd Allah, on the authority of Ibn Fuddal, on the authority of Tha`labah ibn Maymun, on the authority of Hamzah ibn al-Tayyar that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:
“Verily, Allah, the Mighty and High, will hold evidence against the people with what He gave them and made them to recognize.”
